newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PM Guterres urges Arab investment in Portugal.
newsitem.headline: PM Guterres urges Arab investment in Portugal.

text.p: Prime Minister Antonio Guterres, concerned at the low volume of trade between the Arab world and Portugal, on Wednesday called for Arab investment in Portuguese privatisations.
"I would recommend that Arabs invest in the privatisation process," the Socialist leader told a lunch organised by the Portuguese-Arab Chamber of Commerce.
"What worries me is the lack of trade between Portugal and the Arab world," he said.
The trade consists mainly of exports of Portuguese ceramics and plastics and imports of oil.

A recent development was the signing in July of a nonbinding memorandum of understanding between Saudi Aramco and Portuguese state oil company Petrogal and shareholders to assess the possibility of setting up a partnership.
Guterres said Portugal should not rely solely on trade with the European Union for its economic development and should look increasingly to other markets, including Arab states.
"As the European Union grows, trade is becoming more competitive within Europe, so Portugal has to diversify (its markets)," he said.
Guterres said privatisations slated for later this year in Portugal offered promising opportunities for Arab investors.
"Portugal could be an attractive centre for direct Arab investment," he said.
The government is due to sell off tobacco company Tabaqueira and a 45 percent stake in cement group Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal before the end of the year.
